headline: Army Reserve Captain · Operations, Logistics & Program Management
summary: Army Reserve Captain seeking an operations, logistics, or program management role. Commanded a 105-Soldier fuel distribution company with $30 million in property; ran a city recreation program with 62 seasonal staff.

experience.title: Team Executive Officer, Observer Coach/Trainer (OC/T), Captain
experience.company: 2-383rd Training Support Battalion, U.S. Army Reserve
highlights: Serve as second-in-command of a 6-person training and evaluation team that coaches, trains, and evaluates Army Reserve units; have evaluated 5 teams.
Coordinate team personnel, logistics, scheduling, and administrative requirements to execute exercises.
Lead After Action Reviews with unit leaders, measuring performance against Army doctrine and standards.

experience.title: Recreation Supervisor
highlights: Oversaw both City pools (Riverfront Community Center and Wollman Aquatic Center) and the Aquatic Manager; monitored water chemistry, filtration, chlorinators, and HVAC, and arranged repairs.
Planned, marketed, and ran 15 community events a year. The largest, Trunk or Treat, drew 840 people in 2025 and 868 in 2026; the Mayor’s Holiday Lighted Parade and Tree Lighting drew about 300.
Managed contractor agreements for nearly every event; coordinated 45 vendors at each flea market.
Marketed every event and class: monthly emails to 1,600 subscribers, flyers, and RecDesk registration.
Prepared the annual budget, tracked revenues and expenses, and reconciled P-card purchases and invoices in Munis.
Supervised 1 full-time and 62 part-time seasonal staff (recruiting, training, scheduling, evaluations); trained Parks and Recreation staff in First Aid, CPR, AED, and Bloodborne Pathogens.

experience.title: Company Commander, Captain
highlights: Commanded a 105-Soldier petroleum support company in five platoons that distributed 1.5 million gallons of fuel.
Briefed Senator Jerry Moran’s national security staff and the 451st Expeditionary Sustainment Command’s commanding general (2024) on an $8 million maintenance bay.
Oversaw three bulk fuel missions (25,000, 15,000, and 12,000 gallons): received, cleaned, and distributed the fuel.
Initiated two FATCOW refueling missions with Bravo Company, 7-158th Aviation, in New Century, KS: about 3,000 gallons each between CH-47 Chinooks, training 20 Soldiers.
Partnered with the Kansas City Recruiting Battalion: Soldiers represented the unit at 15 events in 8 locations.
Raised medical readiness from about 50% to about 85%; coached 5 Soldiers who failed the Army fitness test to passing.
Accountable for over $30 million in property with no items lost; directed 6 full-time staff.

experience.title: Executive Officer and Platoon Leader, First Lieutenant
highlights: Filled both roles with no XO assigned; ranked 1 of 7 Platoon Leaders and often served as acting commander.
Managed administration, maintenance, logistics, supply, and personnel: 79 soldiers, 103 vehicles, 6 full-time staff.

experience.title: Platoon Leader, Second Lieutenant / First Lieutenant
highlights: Rated one of the top Platoon Leaders by the battalion commander; key to planning annual training on short notice.

experience.title: Aquatic Manager
highlights: Managed 62 part-time seasonal staff across lifeguard, head lifeguard, assistant manager, security, and cashier roles; recruited, trained, and hired most of them.
Oversaw Red Cross Learn-to-Swim (est. 200+ children): 64 lessons each summer, 25+ each other season.
Taught swim lessons, aquacise, 2 to 3 Red Cross Lifeguarding courses a year, and WSI courses; coached the city swim team.

Ran pool operations (water chemistry, filtration, records, opening, closing, maintenance, schedules, timesheets, supplies); booked swim meets, parties, rentals, and swim team, daycare, and school pool time.
Coordinated yearly harassment training with HR and an active shooter drill with the Police Department.

experience.title: Assistant Aquatic Manager
highlights: Acting Aquatic Manager for 2 months in 2018. Earlier: Head Lifeguard (2015–2017), Lifeguard (2013–2015).

education.credential: Bachelor of General Studies, Communication Studies (minor in Business)
